mechanism: Risperidone may increase risk of electrolyte disturbances (hyponatremia, hypocalcemia) and zoledronic acid can cause hypocalcemia and renal impairment, with additive effects on renal function and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, phosphate, magnesium), renal function, and blood pressure regularly; ensure adequate hydration and consider dosage adjustments based on renal function and electrolyte status.
